_comment: Template for onboarding a BRAND-NEW grid. The target carries its own measured emission factors INLINE (emission_renewable / emission_nonrenewable, gCO2/kWh), so no edit to physics/cif.py's EMISSION_FACTOR_TABLES is needed. REPLACE the placeholder factors and paths below with the new region's real measured values before reporting any results -- inline factors intentionally bypass the placeholder EU_*/US_* table rows that cif.py warns against.
